turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided to give my son a zero before anyone picked up a phone?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero on Owen's Hamlet essay withdrawn, an apology for entering it before anyone contacted me, and nothing placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing and still wanting the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a visit to the principal; the fair outcome would be a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and the meeting ended before you got near it.
What moved her: Nothing, because you ended the meeting before saying anything.
What cost ground: Nothing, since you made no move that could cost you.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence came nowhere near that night because none was shown, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she opens by asking who decided on the zero before anyone called, own in one sentence that it went in before you called home, then show her one dated document tied to Owen's own work.
The meeting is over. To practise again, start a new chat and paste the first message from the README.
